queries_run: DoorDash business model transition platform subscription 2026
DoorDash distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 describes two offerings: Marketplaces (DoorDash/Wolt/Deliveroo, with DashPass/Wolt+/Deliveroo Plus memberships, 35M+ members at 2025-12-31) and a Commerce Platform (Drive white-label delivery, online ordering, branded apps) that helps merchants sell on their own channels.
findings.excerpt: In addition to our Marketplaces, we offer our Commerce Platform, which is a suite of services that help empower merchants to build, operate, and grow their businesses on their own channels. Within our Commerce Platform, we offer white-label delivery fulfillment services ("Drive")

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025: substantial majority of revenue still comes from Marketplace orders (commissions and consumer fees); Drive earns per-order fees for fulfilling demand from merchants' own channels. Marketplace remains the main revenue base.
findings.excerpt: We generate a substantial majority of our revenue from orders completed through our Marketplaces and the related commissions charged to partner merchants and fees charged to consumers.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 8-K press release: strategy framed as marketplaces plus services helping merchants sell via their own channels; digital ordering used by 150,000+ merchants with revenue growth over 40% y/y.
findings.excerpt: In Q2 2026, we grew new signed venues at SevenRooms by over 100% Y/Y and grew revenue from our digital ordering service, which is being used by over 150,000 merchants, by over 40% Y/Y.

channel_business_model_shift.note: Search summaries (Q1/Q2 2026 releases) mention rebuilding products on a new global tech platform and merchant first-party channel services; no verbatim text obtained, so only a clue is listed. No evidence found of a structural channel disintermediation. 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
